MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo appropriately captures all key financial terms that are available in this Amendment No. 9 document. This is a technical/administrative amendment that primarily adds definitions related to euro-denominated lending capabilities. The source document does not contain specific interest rates, loan amounts, maturity dates, or detailed covenant terms - it only references that loans will be "Eurocurrency Rate-based" and mentions the EURIBO Rate for euro-denominated loans. The memo correctly identifies these limitations by marking unavailable terms as "N/A" in the deal terms table and noting in the executive summary that this is an administrative amendment focused on technical modifications rather than substantive credit terms. All material parties (Avantor Funding, Inc. as Borrower and Goldman Sachs Bank USA as Administrative Agent) and the key date (April 7, 2022) are properly captured.
